title: Sordland/Turn08/Personal_FrancLeaves
description: Franc leaves for University. Family reacts to that and to Petr.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was a cloudy, rainy day in Holso..."
entries.dialogueText: It was a cloudy, rainy day in Holsord.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The gloomy weather couldn't dampen..."
entries.dialogueText: The gloomy weather couldn't dampen my spirits. My constitutional reforms had passed in court. I had won.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "That wasn't the only cause for exci..."
entries.dialogueText: That wasn't the only cause for excitement in the Rayne household. Today, Franc was finally leaving home.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The gloomy weather echoed my own fe..."
entries.dialogueText: The gloomy weather echoed my own feelings. My constitutional changes had been defeated. I was back to square one.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I couldn't spend the day moping, ho..."
entries.dialogueText: I couldn't spend the day moping, however. Franc was finally about to leave home.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The gloomy weather echoed my own fe..."
entries.dialogueText: The gloomy weather echoed my own feelings. The court had ruled against me. My presidency might be on the line.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But neither the gloomy weather, nor..."
entries.dialogueText: But neither the gloomy weather, nor the unfolding protests, could dampen my spirits following my recent court win.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My son piled the last of his bags n..."
entries.dialogueText: My son piled the last of his bags next to the door. Serge and the assistant driver were waiting outside next to the car.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Did you pack everything?""
entries.dialogueText: "Did you pack everything?"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Don't forget to give me a call *im..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't forget to give me a call *immediately* after you arrive."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica helped him put his backpack..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica helped him put his backpack on while Serge started carrying the luggage to the car.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I made you a sack lunch! I'll get..."
entries.dialogueText: "I made you a sack lunch! I'll get it from the kitchen."

entries.speaker: Deana
entries.title: Deana: ""Franc! Franc!""
entries.dialogueText: "Franc! Franc!"

entries.speaker: Deana
entries.title: Deana: ""I'm gonna miss you.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm gonna miss you."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""I'll miss you too. Don't forget, y..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll miss you too. Don't forget, you've got to give Mom and Dad an extra hard time for both of us now."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Franc picked up his sister and gave..."
entries.dialogueText: Franc picked up his sister and gave her a big hug. Monica appeared in the doorway, holding a paper bag.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I cut the crusts off your sandwich..."
entries.dialogueText: "I cut the crusts off your sandwich, just the way you used to like."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Can't a mother pretend? Oh, Franc!""
entries.dialogueText: "Can't a mother pretend? Oh, Franc!"

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""I'm not a kid anymore, Mom.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not a kid anymore, Mom."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She embraced him with tears in her..."
entries.dialogueText: She embraced him with tears in her eyes. Franc looked as if he was about to cry as well.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Serge approached."
entries.dialogueText: Serge approached.

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""Sir, Franc needs to catch the next..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sir, Franc needs to catch the next flight to Arcasia which leaves from Holsord International in two hours."

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""Sir, Franc needs to catch the next..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sir, Franc needs to catch the next bus to the border in order to report for basic training on time."

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""Sir, Franc needs to catch the next..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sir, Franc needs to catch the next bus to the border to get to the military academy before roll call."

entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""Sir, Franc needs to catch the next..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sir, Franc needs to catch the next ship to United Contana which leaves from Conriat Port in four hours."

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""Sir, as per the schedule, Franc ne..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sir, as per the schedule, Franc needs to be at Holsord State University to start his orientation in an hour."

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""We will have to leave now to make..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will have to leave now to make it."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you, Serge.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Serge."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Time to go, Franc.""

entries.dialogueText: Franc turned around and took one last look at me.

entries.dialogueText: "Home will feel a bit empty now."
entries.menuText: "Home will feel a bit empty now."

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""He will. We all did, after all.""
entries.dialogueText: "He will. We all did, after all."

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner

entries.speaker: Player

entries.menuText: "It is time for him to find himself in the world."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Just make sure he gets there safe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just make sure he gets there safe and sound, Serge."
entries.menuText: "Just make sure he gets there safe and sound, Serge."

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""Of course, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Mr. President."

entries.dialogueText: "I think it will be a liberating experience for him. It's never easy for boys to live in the shadow of their fathers."

entries.dialogueText: "And it must be even harder when one's father is Anton Rayne. A great man like you casts a very long shadow."
